symptom: Re-executing an unchanged script from a checkout at another path rewrote every OData client: `create or modify odata client … ( MetadataUrl: './contracts/f1-metadata.xml' )` had stored `file:///workspaces/…/contracts/f1-metadata.xml` and now stored `file:///home/user/…/contracts/f1-metadata.xml` (5 of 20 writes in the reported project). `describe` printed the absolute form, so describe → exec spread the authoring machine's path into scripts. mx check, build and runtime all clean
cause: The modify branch normalized the statement's relative path to this checkout's absolute file:// URL and assigned it unconditionally, so the stored value always followed whichever checkout ran the script. describe printed the stored absolute URL as is
file: `mdl/executor/cmd_odata.go` (`metadataURLToStore`, `namesSameMetadataFile`, `isRelativeMetadataPath`, `describedMetadataURL`; `refreshCachedMetadata` now takes the fetch URL); test `mdl/executor/cmd_odata_metadata_url_checkout_test.go`; repro `mdl-examples/bug-tests/1499-odata-metadata-url-checkout-path.mdl`
insight: **mx check cannot arbitrate the stored form**: on 11.13.0 it reports 0 errors for './contracts/x.xml', 'contracts/x.xml' AND a dead 'file:///nonexistent/…' alike, so it never reads the value; mx has no headless contract refresh; no Studio Pro-authored ConsumedODataService exists in testdata/, PedApp or mdl-examples. Storing a relative URL would trade a measured defect for an unmeasured Studio Pro one (the skill says its metadata editor keys URL-vs-File on the file:// scheme), so the absolute form stays and the write is elided instead. **'Same file' across checkouts needs the filesystem as tiebreak**: the stored path must end with the statement's project-relative path, and the directory it leaves must either not exist here (another machine, a moved checkout) or hold this project's .mpr (a git worktree); a directory that exists without it (a shared contracts folder) is a different file and the statement moves the client off it. Without the worktree rule two worktrees on one machine flip-flop forever, which is the reported bug again. **Read the contract from this checkout's file, not the kept URL**, or keeping a foreign path costs the refresh. Platform: fresh 11.13 app, exec at P1, mv to P2 and cp to P3: 'documents already in sync' both times (old binary: 'Modified OData client'), mx check 0 errors. describe is project-relative only when './rel' normalizes back to exactly the stored URL, so exec(describe) stays Unchanged
